Subsidie Circular: De subsidieregeling C: Circular Plastics subsidy: the Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) scheme is a funding instrument of the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) aimed at accelerating the transition to circular use of plastics in the Netherlands. The scheme supports research and practical projects across the plastics and recycling value chain.

Kunststof is een van de meest gebruikte: Plastic is one of the most widely used materials in Dutch industry, but recycling and reuse still lag far behind what is technically possible.
Veel plastic eindigt nog altijd als afva: A great deal of plastic still ends up as waste or in low-value applications, even though the value chain can in principle reuse the raw materials. CPNL aims to close that gap: from linear use to demonstrably circular applications.

De subsidieregeling Circular Plastics NL: The Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) subsidy scheme is a funding instrument of the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) aimed at accelerating the transition to circular use of plastics in the Netherlands. The scheme supports research and practical projects across the plastics and recycling value chain.
CPNL is open voor partijen actief in de: CPNL is open to parties active in the plastics and recycling value chain. Participation always takes place in a consortium: a single party cannot apply on its own. Examples include combinations of companies, research institutions and other organisations in the value chain.
